open_issues: Plan deviation, with reason: the plan said no other prompt text changes. The added clause pushed the change verifier to about 1338 tokens against a 1300 budget, and the brief requires the budget to hold. To pay for it I shortened four phrases in the same prompt: 'formatting, clippy, and the tests' to 'fmt, clippy and the tests'; 'would fail' to 'fail'; 'repository's own checks' to 'repository's checks'; and 'the directory Athena sets in CARGO_TARGET_DIR' to 'the CARGO_TARGET_DIR Athena sets'. Meaning is unchanged. The CHANGELOG entry notes this.
Not run: the cargo fmt/clippy/test checks. No Rust source changed, and Athena runs them on the candidate.
Not done: the fresh-reader rating of the live prompt (4 of 5 or higher). It needs a reader outside this job. Athena or the maintainer should obtain it.
Not verifiable here: whether the verifier will copy the command text exactly into the commands list. That is model behavior a prompt edit cannot prove.
mistakes: My first wording of the added clause was too long and pushed the verifier over budget. I shortened it, then trimmed other wording in the same prompt. The plan said to leave the rest of the prompt unchanged, so this departs from the plan.
learnings: The change verifier budget is 1300 estimated tokens (ceil(bytes/3.0)); the set was about 1255 before this edit's additions, so the added clause alone overflows it.
Budget test output prints per-role estimates on the passing run: 'estimated tokens: ... change verifier N ...'.
